name: cbx-orch
description: Durable task orchestration for coding-agent CLIs (codebuddy, opencode, pi)

scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json README.md LICENSE SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md .github/workflows/*.yml src/executor.ts src/plugin-host.ts plugins/example-executor.mjs tests/executor.test.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json README.md LICENSE SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md .github/workflows/*.yml src/executor.ts src/plugin-host.ts plugins/example-executor.mjs tests/executor.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
